decisions: D1 tick rounding (ticks_exact == false) stays a receipt flag, not an export refusal (brief decision 4); the 100 ns test in foundation_contract stays green

D3 guard placement keeps existing error precedence: after OutOfRange in isobmff (track.seek), wav (declared length) and mxf (end > total); wav/pcm/y4m/mxf guards precede every payload read; Truncated/OutOfRange for an unaligned export request are therefore reported as before when they apply first

D5 FieldInfo/CleanAperture follow the brief: clap fields are the eight signed 32-bit values of the Apple clean aperture atom (page re-read 2026-10-11: all eight SInt32)

D6 mxf non-permutation is refused as Corrupt mxf-temporal-offset for Preview too (not Incomplete/Partial): it is the same class as the existing Corrupt for a coded position no display position maps to; refusing in the pre-pass leaves the sink untouched, which an Incomplete after delivery would not; delivered == count holds for every Ok result afterwards, so no unreachable Incomplete branch was added

D7 zero-duration elst: per-track refusal through a private TrackIndex field + public accessor, not a new error variant (no ReelError change, reel-native unaffected); only elst-zero-duration moved per track, edit-media-rate-not-1 and the other index errors stay file-wide

D8 NotExact.nearest means 'a start the same export is accepted at': next whole presented sample for a cut first sample; Case.preview_start in the export test separates the unit a preview delivers from nearest
D9 the PLR-057 pre-check is skipped for Preview (seek would move OutOfRange ahead of decoder-open errors); for Export it also moves OutOfRange before the session open

items.1_repeated_media_sample: verified against the code before editing: build_edits accepts overlapping media ranges, build_presentation pushes a sample once per covering edit, deliver_packets keyed slots by media sample (last presented entry wins), delivered counted distinct samples, complete was the constant true. Fixed (see capabilities R10-1). Decision: report-the-true-count rather than one chunk per presented entry, because the decoded-video route tags pictures by chunk.index (video.rs Pump/Forward match pending packets by sample index), so a re-fed sample would collide tags and re-decode an inter frame; the decoded-video leg already reported Partial/Incomplete and is unchanged
items.2_read_timecode_start: verified: a refused tmcd track has presented cleared, so tc.presented.first() was None and the call returned Ok(None); fixed with require_supported on the named track and on the tmcd track. Every other TrackIndex accessor reviewed: seek/probe/select_track refuse; edits and presented() are empty; pcm() stream window is now Err(Unsupported elst-zero-duration); samples()/sync_samples()/is_all_sync() are raw sample-table facts (documented); default_track() still returns a refused first video track (residual R8, documented on unsupported())
items.3_plr062: verified: the pre-check at video.rs covered the start only, deliver_packets reported a count past the end as OutOfRange after the session had opened; extended to the whole range; the in-process rav1d Export arm now has tests

behaviour_changes: Export of a packet range that presents one media sample more than once: Ok, Exact, complete true (2 of 4 units) -> ReelError::Incomplete {requested, delivered = different media samples}, before the first read

Preview of such a range: Ok, Exact, complete true, chunks at the LAST presented entry's pts -> Ok, Partial, complete false, actual.units = units delivered, each media sample at its FIRST presented entry (outcome_for: Failure(Loss), as for any incomplete receipt)

Export (decoded video) whose count runs past the end: OutOfRange after the decoder session opened -> OutOfRange before it (a worker host spawns no worker); Preview order unchanged (session opens, then OutOfRange)
read_timecode_start of a refused track or of a refused tmcd track: Ok(None) (or the refused video track's timecode) -> Unsupported elst-zero-duration
a refused compact-PCM track: stream window Err(pcm-window-unset) -> Err(Unsupported elst-zero-duration)

mxf/wav/y4m/PCM receipts: complete and Partial now derived from the delivered count through the shared helpers (no behaviour change for any input that delivered everything; pcm actual.units is the loop cursor)
decisions: D1 packet delivery stays one chunk per MEDIA sample (decode order) because the video route keys pictures by sample index; the repeated presented entries are reported, not re-fed

D2 the Export refusal for a repeating range is Incomplete (the brief's 'fewer units delivered than requested -> typed error'), not a new error variant; delivered = different media samples in the range
D3 delivery_complete takes strict equality (delivered == requested); more units than requested is also not complete

D4 PLR-062 test through the in-process arm uses an av1C whose sequence-header OBU claims 127 bytes of payload and holds 13: parse_av1c only splits the record, rav1d refuses the open (Corrupt av1-bitstream), so a range error from that file proves the session open was never reached; the chunk-limit trick of the 1080p test fails at the first send, not at open, and was dropped after it did not go red

D5 the Export distinct-sample count allocates a Vec<u32> of the requested presented entries after the range check (bounded by the presented table, Export only); a count of u64::MAX is OutOfRange before it (pinned in the test)
